summary: ONE_NO_COST_FORWARD_SOURCE_DESIGN_READY. Sole ranked family: CFTC CME Bitcoin Commitments of Traders. Official CFTC documentation establishes a credential-free regulator source, Tuesday close observation boundary, general Friday 3:30 p.m. ET publication, weekly cadence, three-day processing lag, static weekly/history availability, classification methodology, and no backdated historical updates. It is causally distinct from R1 price candles, R2 trades/books5, carry, and the derived 3% shock lane. Deribit options are not selected because complete instrument/surface semantics, retention, revision and reuse terms are not proven by the listed page. OKX liquidation events fail source sufficiency because the official documentation says the public channel is recent, non-total and nonchronological while historical REST access was removed. The mempool project proves open-source provenance and self-hostability but not a frozen point-in-time fee-state schema, timestamp, revision or retention contract. No blended feed, formula, threshold, direction, horizon, strategy, hypothesis, candidate, manifest, experiment or OOS action was created. Immediate PnL and drawdown effect are zero; predictive and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF.

A continuous WebSocket with unprovable gap recovery cannot meet the frozen source-sufficiency boundary.
